names.details: Sebā: It is a big city in the vilāyet-i Yemen (province of Yemen). It was built by Sebā bin Neşḥat (Saba son of Nashḥat). But now it lies in ruins. Its flourishing period was in the time when Belḳīs (Bilqīs / Queen of Sheba) married Ḥażret-i Süleymān Nebī ʿaleyhi’s-selām (the Prophet Solomon, peace be upon him). [translation]

names.details: Another well-known city of the arż-ı Ḥaḍramūt (the land of Hadramawt) is Sebā (Saba), which God has mentioned in the Noble Qur’an. Many people from the provinces of Yemen and ‘Ummān (Oman) had gathered there. The name of that city was Me’rib (Ma’rib, Yemen), which was the name of the king of that land. [translation]
